note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: What heat source and combustion service apply to this unit, and what do existing records establish about any applicable air/fuel operating basis?

evidence.text: equipment F-A reads "F-A Fired unit A"

evidence.role: represented fuel, air or flue stream context
evidence.text: stream FUEL-A (asset stream:FUEL-A) reads "Natural gas fuel A" at F-A

evidence.role: represented fuel, air or flue stream context
evidence.text: stream FLUE-A (asset stream:FLUE-A) reads "Flue gas A"
F-A fuel_service = "natural gas"; present; meaning and suitability unverified
F-A operating_basis = "unknown"; blank; meaning and suitability unverified
Supplied candidate fact, basis unverified: F-A fuel_service = natural gas

where: site records: permitted existing equipment/service description, heat-source/fuel and operating records with source/revision, asset scope and responsible owner; establish whether combustion applies before any gas-analysis request
data_requests.how: A boiler or heater label and a missing fuel stream do not establish either combustion or non-combustion service. Review the existing source basis first. If the supplied scope is electric or unfired with no relevant burner, acknowledge that scope as not applicable to combustion review; do not impose flue/O2/trim work. Unknown heat/fuel service remains a qualification question, not a quiet completed result.

data_requests.item: Applicable existing analysis, metering, control and constraint records
where: site records: only where combustion applies: existing tuning, paired air/fuel-flow or flue-analysis records, appropriate calibration/method and representative firing/load basis, current control purpose/configuration/modes and equipment/process constraints
DCS/PLC configuration: only applicable permitted existing configuration records for the identified unit; this request grants no access, measurement or execution permission
data_requests.how: For applicable combustion service, use suitable existing air/fuel metering, flue analysis or both; permanent O2 hardware and new portable analysis are not mandatory. Preserve supplied record scope, false and unknown qualifiers. Product/headspace or foreign oxygen is not this unit’s combustion basis; analysis is not enabled feedback trim. Adequate records or documented non-applicability may settle or defer the job without new collection or a project. Do not prescribe operating settings or adjustment.

questions.decision_rule: Establish heat source and combustion applicability from qualified existing records before evaluating the operating/control basis. Explicit electric or unfired scope does not create O2/trim work; unknown fuel service is not evidence of non-applicability. Where combustion applies, acknowledge existing analysis/metering and modes, then review unresolved evidence. Adequate coverage may answer or defer the job without a project. This screen neither declares installed control nor tracks completed investigation/work status.

typical_benefit.wording: S19 Section8.1/Table6 reports historical boiler combustion/excess-air measures, not a guaranteed benefit from adding O2 trim. S27 supports reviewing air/fuel-flow or flue-analysis methods and equipment/process constraints. No quantified benefit is assigned to this records-review question.
source_titles: S19: Worrell & Galitsky, Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for Petroleum Refineries: An ENERGY STAR Guide (LBNL-56183, Feb 2005)
S27: DOE Industrial Technologies Program, Process Heating Tip Sheet #2, Check Burner Air to Fuel Ratios (Nov 2007)
S24: DOE IAC/ITAC database: browse pages, download, schema document

questions.limits: This screen covers represented boilers, fired heaters, furnaces and kilns; steam generators and reactors are outside this route’s current scope. Those exclusions do not establish whether combustion review is useful for excluded equipment. Incomplete fuel records remain reviewable; missing fuel context is not proof of non-combustion service. Supplied qualifications/Booleans are not installed-state or company acceptance. S19 reviewed official ENERGY STAR122-page edition, printed37–39/PDFindices44–46, https://www.energystar.gov/sites/default/files/buildings/tools/ES_Petroleum_Energy_Guide.pdf; byte equality with the OSTI route is unverified. S27 supports alternative methods and conditional operating bases. Historical boiler figures and ARC aggregates do not establish all-fired savings or control deficiencies.
